blind.description: A stylized low-poly wooden defensive obstacle (cheval de frise / spiked log barricade). It features a central horizontal cylindrical log bound at both ends with riveted dark grey metal bands. Protruding through the main trunk are pairs of crossed wooden stakes angled outwards, each sharpened to a lighter-colored conical point. The model rests on the lower tips of the stakes or the central log itself on the ground without any separate base. All geometry is solid, continuous, and stylized cartoon/low-poly with warm brown wood grain textures and metallic cuffs; no floating fragments, holes, or glowing elements are present.
blind.from_above: Seen from directly overhead, it appears as a horizontal brown log flanked on both sides by alternating rows of sharpened wooden spike tips pointing diagonally outward and upward, with dark studded metal rings encircling each end of the log.
blind.height_vs_figure: About one-third to one-half the height of the figure (around 2 to 2.5 ft tall) and roughly the length of the figure's height (about 5.5 to 6 ft long).

notes: underside: the mesh's middle is not over what touches the floor (leaning or cantilevered)
